description: [read-only] Compute a unified diff between two object versions. Pass the two opaque content_uris from GetObjectVersions entries; returns the unified diff (jsdiff) of their sources.

content_uri_from.description: Opaque content_uri of the OLD/base version (from a GetObjectVersions entry).

content_uri_to.description: Opaque content_uri of the NEW/compare version (from a GetObjectVersions entry).

object_type.description: Object type (same value used in GetObjectVersions).

name: GetObjectVersionDiff
